invariants.claim: A Tempo transaction envelope is prefixed with EIP-2718 type byte 0x76.

Canonical RLP field order is chain_id, max_priority_fee_per_gas, max_fee_per_gas, gas_limit, calls, access_list, nonce_key, nonce, valid_before, valid_after, fee_token, fee_payer_signature, aa_authorization_list, optional key_authorization, sender_signature.
The sender signs keccak256(0x76 || rlp(base fields)); fee_token is empty and fee_payer_signature is 0x00 when a fee payer will co-sign.
The fee payer signs keccak256(0x78 || rlp(base fields with fee_token set and sender address in the fee_payer_signature slot)).
When present, key_authorization is included in both sender and fee-payer signing preimages (TEMPO-2).
Sender secp256k1 signatures are 65 bytes r||s||v; fee-payer signatures are RLP tuples [yParity, r, s].
RLP integers are minimal big-endian; zero encodes as the empty string (0x80).

survivor_review: Twelve mutants (three canaries) target native/onchain_tempo glue, Codec signing, Transaction co-sign mapping, and Builder field order. All were killed by the ox vector, key_authorization, and recovery oracle; no equivalent or unreachable survivors.
